about.title: About this project
about.projectDescription: A Swagger/OpenAPI UI with REST client capabilities: edit OpenAPI specifications in JSON or YAML, browse the endpoints they define, and execute real requests through a CORS-free server proxy. Authenticated users can save schemas and review the full history and analytics of their requests.
about.courseDescription: This application is the final task of the RS School React course. RS School is a free-of-charge and community-based education program conducted by The Rolling Scopes developer community since 2013. Anyone can study regardless of age, professional employment, or place of residence.
